title: Universal injectivity of a completed direct sum into a product
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof describes completion by coordinate families that converge I-adically, but ordinary injectivity is insufficient. Uniform Artin-Rees bounds lift each relation while preserving convergence, proving injectivity after tensoring with every finite module.
